    private List<ConversationThread>? _threads;
    private ConversationThread? _selectedThread;
    private int _totalCount;
    private string _replyBody = "";
    private IBrowserFile? _pendingFile;

    private Dictionary<int, FileAttachment> _attachmentCache = new();
    private HashSet<int> _fetchingAttachments = new();

    // Yeni Mesaj modalı
    private bool _showNewMsgModal;
    private int? _newMsgRecipientId;
    private string _newMsgBody = string.Empty;
    private bool _newMsgSending;
    private List<User> _allUsers = [];

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadMessages();
    }

    private async Task LoadMessages()
    {
        if (SessionSvc.IsLoggedIn)
        {
            int myId = SessionSvc.ActiveUser.UserId;
            var result = await MessageSvc.GetUserMessagesAsync(myId);
            if (result.IsSuccess)
            {
                var messages = result.Data ?? [];
                _threads = GroupMessagesIntoThreads(messages, myId);
                _totalCount = _threads.Sum(t => t.UnreadCount);
                
                if (_selectedThread != null)
                {
                    _selectedThread = _threads.FirstOrDefault(t => t.Key == _selectedThread.Key);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private List<ConversationThread> GroupMessagesIntoThreads(List<CommunicationMessage> messages, int myUserId)
    {
        var dict = new Dictionary<string, ConversationThread>();

        foreach (var msg in messages.OrderBy(m => m.CreatedAt))
        {
            string key;
            string title;
            string icon;
            int? ctxDeptId = null;
            int? ctxOtherUserId = null;

            if (msg.AttachmentId.HasValue && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(msg.AttachmentType))
            {
                key = $"Ctx_{msg.AttachmentType}_{msg.AttachmentId}";
                title = $"{msg.AttachmentType} #{msg.AttachmentId} Konuşması";
                icon = msg.AttachmentType == "Task" ? "bi-check2-square text-success" : 
                       msg.AttachmentType == "Meeting" ? "bi-calendar-event text-info" : "bi-paperclip text-primary";
            }
            else if (msg.ReceiverDepartmentId.HasValue)
            {
                key = $"Dept_{msg.ReceiverDepartmentId}";
                title = "Departman Kanalı";
                icon = "bi-building text-warning";
                ctxDeptId = msg.ReceiverDepartmentId;
            }
            else if (msg.SenderUserId == null)
            {
                key = "System";
                title = "Sistem Bildirimleri";
                icon = "bi-bell-fill text-secondary";
            }
            else
            {
                var otherUser = msg.SenderUserId == myUserId ? msg.ReceiverUserId : msg.SenderUserId;
                key = $"User_{otherUser}";
                title = $"Kullanıcı {otherUser}";
                icon = "bi-person-fill text-primary";
                ctxOtherUserId = otherUser;
            }

            if (!dict.TryGetValue(key, out var thread))
            {
                thread = new ConversationThread(myUserId)
                {
                    Key = key,
                    Title = title,
                    Icon = icon,
                    ContextAttachmentType = msg.AttachmentId.HasValue ? msg.AttachmentType : null,
                    ContextAttachmentId = msg.AttachmentId.HasValue ? msg.AttachmentId : null,
                    ContextDepartmentId = ctxDeptId,
                    ContextOtherUserId = ctxOtherUserId
                };
                dict[key] = thread;
            }
            
            thread.Messages.Add(msg);
        }

        return dict.Values.OrderByDescending(t => t.LastMessageAt).ToList();
    }

    private async Task SelectThread(ConversationThread thread)
    {
        _selectedThread = thread;
        
        var unreads = thread.Messages.Where(m => !m.IsRead && m.SenderUserId != SessionSvc.ActiveUser.UserId).ToList();
        foreach (var msg in unreads)
        {
            await MessageSvc.MarkAsReadAsync(msg.Id);
            msg.IsRead = true;
        }
        
        if (_threads != null)
        {
            _totalCount = _threads.Sum(t => t.UnreadCount);
        }
    }

    private async Task PrepareNewMessage()
    {
        _newMsgBody = string.Empty;
        _newMsgRecipientId = null;
        _newMsgSending = false;

        if (_allUsers.Count == 0)
        {
            var usersRes = await UserSvc.GetAllAsync(onlyActive: true);
            if (usersRes.IsSuccess && usersRes.Data != null)
            {
                // Kendimizi listeden çıkar
                _allUsers = usersRes.Data
                    .Where(u => u.Id != SessionSvc.ActiveUser?.UserId)
                    .ToList();
            }
        }

        _showNewMsgModal = true;
    }

    private async Task SendNewMessageAsync()
    {
        if (_newMsgRecipientId is null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_newMsgBody))
        {
            ToastSvc.ShowWarning("Alıcı ve mesaj içeriği zorunludur.");
            return;
        }

        _newMsgSending = true;

        var msg = new CommunicationMessage
        {
            SenderUserId   = SessionSvc.ActiveUser?.UserId ?? 0,
            ReceiverUserId = _newMsgRecipientId,
            Body           = _newMsgBody.Trim(),
            Type           = MessageType.UserMessage,
            CreatedAt      = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        var result = await MessageSvc.SendMessageAsync(msg);

        _newMsgSending = false;

        if (result.IsSuccess)
        {
            _showNewMsgModal = false;
            ToastSvc.ShowSuccess("Mesaj gönderildi.");
            await LoadMessages();
        }
        else
        {
            ToastSvc.ShowError("Mesaj gönderilemedi: " + result.Message);
        }
    }

    private async Task SendReply()
    {
        if ((string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_replyBody) && _pendingFile == null) || _selectedThread == null) return;

        int? uploadedId = null;
        string? attachmentType = _selectedThread.ContextAttachmentType;
        int? attachmentId = _selectedThread.ContextAttachmentId;

        if (_pendingFile != null)
        {
            var uploadRes = await AttachmentSvc.UploadAttachmentAsync(_pendingFile, "Message", 0, SessionSvc.ActiveUser.UserId);
            if (uploadRes.IsSuccess)
            {
                uploadedId = uploadRes.Data;
                attachmentType = "File";
                attachmentId = uploadedId;
            }
            else
            {
                ToastSvc.ShowError("Dosya yüklenemedi: " + uploadRes.Message);
                return;
            }
        }

        var newMsg = new CommunicationMessage
        {
            SenderUserId = SessionSvc.ActiveUser.UserId,
            ReceiverUserId = _selectedThread.ContextOtherUserId,
            ReceiverDepartmentId = _selectedThread.ContextDepartmentId,
            Body = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_replyBody) ? (_pendingFile?.Name ?? "Dosya eklendi") : _replyBody,
            Type = MessageType.UserMessage,
            AttachmentType = attachmentType,
            AttachmentId = attachmentId,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        var result = await MessageSvc.SendMessageAsync(newMsg);
        if (result.IsSuccess)
        {
            _replyBody = "";
            _pendingFile = null;
            await LoadMessages();
        }
    }

    private void OnInputFileChange(InputFileChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _pendingFile = e.File;
    }

    private void ClearPendingFile() => _pendingFile = null;

    private async Task HandleKeyDown(KeyboardEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Key == "Enter" && !e.ShiftKey)
        {
            await SendReply();
        }
    }

    private FileAttachment? GetCachedAttachment(int id)
    {
        _attachmentCache.TryGetValue(id, out var att);
        return att;
    }

    private string TriggerAttachmentFetch(int id)
    {
        if (!_fetchingAttachments.Contains(id))
        {
            _fetchingAttachments.Add(id);
            _ = FetchAttachmentAsync(id);
        }
        return "";
    }

    private async Task FetchAttachmentAsync(int id)
    {
        var res = await AttachmentSvc.GetAttachmentByIdAsync(id);
        if (res.IsSuccess && res.Data != null)
        {
            _attachmentCache[id] = res.Data;
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        }
    }

    private string GetFileIcon(string? contentType) => contentType switch
    {
        var ct when ct?.Contains("image") == true => "bi-file-earmark-image",
        var ct when ct?.Contains("pdf") == true => "bi-file-earmark-pdf",
        var ct when ct?.Contains("word") == true => "bi-file-earmark-word",
        var ct when ct?.Contains("excel") == true => "bi-file-earmark-spreadsheet",
        _ => "bi-file-earmark-text"
    };

    private string GetAttachmentUrl(string? type, int id)
    {
        return type switch
        {
            "Task" => $"/gorev/{id}",
            "Meeting" => $"/toplanti/{id}",
            "Report" => $"/rapor/{id}",
            "Query" => $"/sorgu/{id}",
            _ => "/"
        };
    }
}

@code {
    private AiSidebar? _aiSidebar;
    private Dictionary<string, object> _aiParams = new();
    private void ToggleAiSidebar() { _aiSidebar?.Toggle(); }

    private bool _isLoading = true;
    private QueryResult _statusResult = default!;
    private QueryResult _messageResult = default!;
    private QueryResult _trendResult = default!;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task RefreshAll() => await LoadData();

    /// <summary>
    /// Analitik grafik verilerini servis katmanından yükler. SQL bu sayfada değil AnalyticsService içinde tanımlıdır.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        _isLoading = true;

        var trendRes = await AnalyticsSvc.GetTaskTrendResultAsync();
        _trendResult = trendRes.IsSuccess && trendRes.Data != null ? trendRes.Data : new QueryResult { Name = "Görev Verimlilik Trendi" };

        var msgRes = await AnalyticsSvc.GetMessageActivityResultAsync();
        _messageResult = msgRes.IsSuccess && msgRes.Data != null ? msgRes.Data : new QueryResult { Name = "Mesajlaşma Aktivitesi" };

        var statusRes = await AnalyticsSvc.GetTaskStatusDistributionResultAsync();
        _statusResult = statusRes.IsSuccess && statusRes.Data != null ? statusRes.Data : new QueryResult { Name = "Görev Durum Dağılımı" };

        _isLoading = false;
    }
}

@code {
    private static readonly string[] _dayNames = ["Pzt", "Sal", "Çar", "Per", "Cum", "Cmt", "Paz"];
    private bool _isLoading = true;
    private int _pendingTaskCount, _pendingDecisionCount, _monthlyTotalEventsCount;
    private int _actionRate, _decisionDensity, _calendarOccupancy, _panelReadiness;
    private DateTime _displayedMonth = new(DateTime.Today.Year, DateTime.Today.Month, 1);
    private DateTime _selectedDay = DateTime.Today;
    private readonly Dictionary<DateTime, List<CalendarEvent>> _calendarMap = [];
    private List<CalendarWeek> _calendarWeeks = [];
    private List<TaskItem> _tasks = [];
    private List<Decision> _decisions = [];
    private List<QuerySet> _dashboardSets = [];
    private List<Lookup> _taskStatuses = [], _decisionStatuses = [];
    private List<KpiTarget> _kpiTargets = [];
    private List<Objective> _topObjectives = [];
    private List<ApprovalRequest> _pendingApprovals = [];

    private AiSidebar? _aiSidebar;
    private Dictionary<string, object> _aiParams => new();
    private void ToggleAiSidebar() { _aiSidebar?.Toggle(); }

    private string DisplayedMonthTitle => _displayedMonth.ToString("MMMM yyyy", CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("tr-TR"));
    private string SelectedDayTitle => _selectedDay.ToString("dd MMMM yyyy, dddd", CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("tr-TR"));
    private List<CalendarEvent> SelectedDayEvents => _calendarMap.TryGetValue(_selectedDay.Date, out var list) ? list.OrderBy(x => x.Priority).ThenBy(x => x.Title).ToList() : [];

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _isLoading = true;
        _pendingTaskCount = (await TaskSvc.GetPendingTaskCountAsync()).Data;
        _pendingDecisionCount = (await MeetingSvc.GetPendingDecisionCountAsync()).Data;
        _tasks = (await TaskSvc.ListPendingTasksAsync(5)).Data ?? [];
        _decisions = (await MeetingSvc.ListLatestDecisionsAsync(5)).Data ?? [];
        _actionRate = (await TaskSvc.GetActionRateAsync()).Data;
        _decisionDensity = (await MeetingSvc.GetDecisionDensityAsync()).Data;
        
        var setsRes = await QuerySetSvc.GetAllAsync();
        _dashboardSets = (setsRes.Data ?? []).Where(x => x.Type == "Dashboard").ToList();
        _panelReadiness = _dashboardSets.Count == 0 ? 10 : Math.Min(100, _dashboardSets.Count * 25);

        _taskStatuses = await LookupSvc.ListByGroupAsync("TaskStatus");
        _decisionStatuses = await LookupSvc.ListByGroupAsync("DecisionStatus");

        var kpiRes = await KpiSvc.ListAsync();
        _kpiTargets = kpiRes.IsSuccess ? (kpiRes.Data ?? []) : [];

        // OKR: mevcut yıl aktif hedeflerin ilk 4'ü
        var okrRes = await OkrSvc.ListAsync(DateTime.Today.Year);
        _topObjectives = (okrRes.IsSuccess ? (okrRes.Data ?? []) : [])
            .OrderByDescending(o => o.Progress).Take(4).ToList();

        // Bekleyen onaylar: giriş yapan kullanıcı için
        var userId = SessionSvc.ActiveUser?.UserId ?? 0;
        if (userId > 0)
        {
            var apprRes = await ApprovalSvc.GetPendingForUserAsync(userId);
            _pendingApprovals = apprRes.IsSuccess ? (apprRes.Data ?? []) : [];
        }

        await LoadCalendarMonthAsync();
        _calendarOccupancy = Math.Clamp(_monthlyTotalEventsCount * 4, 5, 100);
        _isLoading = false;
    }

    private async Task ChangeMonthAsync(int monthDiff) { _displayedMonth = _displayedMonth.AddMonths(monthDiff); await LoadCalendarMonthAsync(); }
    private async Task SelectDayAsync(DateTime day) {
        if (day.Month != _displayedMonth.Month || day.Year != _displayedMonth.Year) {
            _displayedMonth = new DateTime(day.Year, day.Month, 1);
            await LoadCalendarMonthAsync();
        }
        _selectedDay = day.Date;
    }

    private async Task LoadCalendarMonthAsync() {
        _calendarMap.Clear();
        var monthStart = new DateTime(_displayedMonth.Year, _displayedMonth.Month, 1);
        var res = await CalendarSvc.ListAsync(monthStart, monthStart.AddMonths(1).AddDays(-1));
        var events = res.Data ?? [];
        foreach (var group in events.GroupBy(x => x.Date.Date)) _calendarMap[group.Key] = group.ToList();
        _monthlyTotalEventsCount = events.Count;
        _calendarWeeks = BuildWeeks(monthStart);
    }

    private int GetEventCountForDay(DateTime day) => _calendarMap.TryGetValue(day.Date, out var list) ? list.Count : 0;
    private string GetDayButtonClass(DateTime day) {
        var cls = "yi-day-btn ";
        if (day.Date == _selectedDay.Date) cls += "yi-day-selected ";
        else if (GetEventCountForDay(day) > 0) cls += "yi-day-has-events ";
        else cls += "yi-day-normal ";
        if (day.Month != _displayedMonth.Month) cls += "yi-day-outside ";
        if (day.Date == DateTime.Today) cls += "yi-day-today ";
        return cls.TrimEnd();
    }

    private List<CalendarWeek> BuildWeeks(DateTime monthStart) {
        var offset = ((int)monthStart.DayOfWeek + 6) % 7;
        var start = monthStart.AddDays(-offset);
        return Enumerable.Range(0, 6).Select(w => new CalendarWeek { Days = Enumerable.Range(0, 7).Select(d => start.AddDays(w * 7 + d)).ToList() }).ToList();
    }

    private string GetDayAriaLabel(DateTime day)
    {
        var label = day.ToString("d MMMM", CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("tr-TR"));
        if (day.Date == DateTime.Today) label += ", bugün";
        var count = GetEventCountForDay(day);
        if (count > 0) label += $", {count} olay";
        return label;
    }

    private sealed class CalendarWeek { public List<DateTime> Days { get; set; } = []; }
}

@code {
    [Parameter] public int Id { get; set; }

    private bool _isNew => Id == 0;
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _saving;
    private bool _testing;
    private bool _showConnStr;
    private bool? _testResult;
    private string? _testMessage;
    private string? _formError;

    private YonetIQ.Data.Models.DataSource _model = new() { IsActive = true, ServerType = "MSSQL" };

    // ─── Sihirbaz modu ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    private bool   _wizardMode    = false;
    private bool   _showWizardPwd = false;
    private string _wHost         = string.Empty;
    private string _wPort         = string.Empty;
    private string _wDatabase     = string.Empty;
    private string _wAuthType     = "SQL";    // "SQL" | "Windows"
    private string _wUsername     = string.Empty;
    private string _wPassword     = string.Empty;
    private bool   _wTrustCert    = true;
    private bool   _wEncrypt      = false;
    private string _wPgSslMode    = "Prefer";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        if (!_isNew)
        {
            var res = await DataSourceSvc.GetByIdAsync(Id);
            if (res.IsSuccess && res.Data is not null)
                _model = res.Data;
            else
            {
                Toast.ShowError("Veri kaynağı bulunamadı.");
                Nav.NavigateTo("/veri-kaynaklari");
                return;
            }
        }
        _loading = false;
    }

    private async Task TestConnectionAsync()
    {
        _formError = null;

        // Sihirbaz modundaysa önce connection string'i oluştur
        if (_wizardMode)
            BuildConnectionString();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_model.PlainConnectionString))
        {
            _formError = _wizardMode
                ? "Lütfen sunucu, veritabanı ve kimlik bilgilerini doldurup 'Bağlantı Dizisi Oluştur' butonuna basın veya doğrudan 'Ham Metin' modunda yazın."
                : "Önce bağlantı dizisini girin.";
            return;
        }

        _testing    = true;
        _testResult = null;
        _testMessage = null;

        try
        {
            var (success, error) = await DataSourceService.TestConnectionAsync(
                _model.ServerType, _model.PlainConnectionString);

            _testResult  = success;
            _testMessage = success
                ? $"{_model.ServerType} bağlantısı başarılı ✓"
                : $"Bağlantı başarısız: {error}";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _testResult  = false;
            _testMessage = $"Test hatası: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            _testing = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task SaveAsync()
    {
        _formError = null;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_model.Name))
        {
            _formError = "Veri kaynağı adı zorunludur.";
            return;
        }

        // Sihirbaz modundaysa önce connection string'i oluştur
        if (_wizardMode)
            BuildConnectionString();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_model.PlainConnectionString))
        {
            _formError = _wizardMode
                ? "Sunucu ve veritabanı bilgilerini doldurduktan sonra 'Bağlantı Dizisi Oluştur' butonuna basın."
                : "Bağlantı dizisi zorunludur.";
            return;
        }

        _saving = true;
        try
        {
            var res = await DataSourceSvc.SaveAsync(_model);
            if (res.IsSuccess)
            {
                Toast.ShowSuccess(_isNew ? "Veri kaynağı eklendi." : "Değişiklikler kaydedildi.");
                Nav.NavigateTo("/veri-kaynaklari");
            }
            else
            {
                _formError = res.Message ?? "Kaydetme başarısız.";
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _formError = $"Kaydetme sırasında hata oluştu: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            _saving = false;
        }
    }

    // ─── Sihirbaz yardımcıları ───────────────────────────────────────────

    private void SwitchToWizard()
    {
        ParseConnectionString(); // mevcut ham stringi parse et
        _wizardMode = true;
    }

    private void SwitchToRaw()
    {
        _wizardMode = false;
    }

    /// <summary>Ham bağlantı dizisini wizard alanlarına dönüştürür (best-effort).</summary>
    private void ParseConnectionString()
    {
        var cs = _model.PlainConnectionString ?? string.Empty;
        var dict = cs.Split(';', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
            .Select(p => p.Split('=', 2))
            .Where(p => p.Length == 2)
            .GroupBy(p => p[0].Trim(), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Last()[1].Trim(), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        string Get(params string[] keys) =>
            keys.Select(k => dict.TryGetValue(k, out var v) ? v : null).FirstOrDefault(v => v is not null) ?? string.Empty;

        switch (_model.ServerType)
        {
            case "MSSQL":
                var server = Get("Server", "Data Source");
                var commaIdx = server.IndexOf(',');
                if (commaIdx >= 0) { _wHost = server[..commaIdx]; _wPort = server[(commaIdx + 1)..]; }
                else               { _wHost = server; _wPort = string.Empty; }
                _wDatabase  = Get("Database", "Initial Catalog");
                var intSec  = Get("Integrated Security", "Trusted_Connection");
                _wAuthType  = intSec.Equals("true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                           || intSec.Equals("sspi", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "Windows" : "SQL";
                _wUsername  = Get("User Id", "UID");
                _wPassword  = Get("Password", "PWD");
                _wTrustCert = Get("TrustServerCertificate").Equals("true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                _wEncrypt   = Get("Encrypt").Equals("true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                break;
            case "PostgreSQL":
                _wHost      = Get("Host");
                _wPort      = Get("Port");
                _wDatabase  = Get("Database");
                _wUsername  = Get("Username");
                _wPassword  = Get("Password");
                _wPgSslMode = Get("SSL Mode");
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_wPgSslMode)) _wPgSslMode = "Prefer";
                break;
            case "MySQL":
                _wHost     = Get("Server");
                _wPort     = Get("Port");
                _wDatabase = Get("Database");
                _wUsername = Get("User", "Username");
                _wPassword = Get("Password");
                break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Wizard alanlarından bağlantı dizisi üretir ve modele yazar.</summary>
    private void BuildConnectionString()
    {
        _model.PlainConnectionString = _model.ServerType switch
        {
            "MSSQL"      => BuildMssqlConnStr(),
            "PostgreSQL" => BuildPgConnStr(),
            "MySQL"      => BuildMysqlConnStr(),
            _            => _model.PlainConnectionString
        };
    }

    private string BuildMssqlConnStr()
    {
        var server = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_wPort) ? _wHost : $"{_wHost},{_wPort}";
        var parts  = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>
        {
            $"Server={server}",
            $"Database={_wDatabase}"
        };
        if (_wAuthType == "Windows")
            parts.Add("Integrated Security=True");
        else
        {
            parts.Add($"User Id={_wUsername}");
            parts.Add($"Password={_wPassword}");
        }
        if (_wTrustCert) parts.Add("TrustServerCertificate=True");
        if (_wEncrypt)   parts.Add("Encrypt=True");
        return string.Join(";", parts);
    }

    private string BuildPgConnStr()
    {
        var parts = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>
        {
            $"Host={_wHost}",
            $"Database={_wDatabase}",
            $"Username={_wUsername}",
            $"Password={_wPassword}"
        };
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_wPort))      parts.Add($"Port={_wPort}");
        if (_wPgSslMode != "Prefer" && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_wPgSslMode))
            parts.Add($"SSL Mode={_wPgSslMode}");
        return string.Join(";", parts);
    }

    private string BuildMysqlConnStr()
    {
        var parts = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>
        {
            $"Server={_wHost}",
            $"Database={_wDatabase}",
            $"User={_wUsername}",
            $"Password={_wPassword}"
        };
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_wPort)) parts.Add($"Port={_wPort}");
        return string.Join(";", parts) + ";";
    }

    private static string MaskConnStr(string cs)
    {
        // Şifre değerini maskele
        return System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(
            cs,
            @"(Password|PWD|pwd)\s*=\s*[^;]+",
            m => m.Value.Split('=')[0] + "=********",
            System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
    }

    private string GetHostPlaceholder() => _model.ServerType switch
    {
        "PostgreSQL" => "db.example.com",
        "MySQL"      => "db.example.com",
        _            => "SUNUCU\\SQLEXPRESS veya 192.168.1.10"
    };

    private string GetDefaultPort() => _model.ServerType switch
    {
        "PostgreSQL" => "5432",
        "MySQL"      => "3306",
        _            => "1433"
    };

    private string GetUsernamePlaceholder() => _model.ServerType switch
    {
        "PostgreSQL" => "postgres",
        "MySQL"      => "root",
        _            => "sa"
    };

    private string GetConnStrPlaceholder() => _model.ServerType switch
    {
        "PostgreSQL" => "Host=sunucu;Database=db;Username=user;Password=pass",
        "MySQL"      => "Server=sunucu;Database=db;User=user;Password=pass;",
        _            => "Server=SUNUCU;Database=DB;Integrated Security=True;"
    };

    private static string GetServerBadgeClass(string serverType) => serverType.ToUpperInvariant() switch
    {
        "POSTGRESQL" or "POSTGRES" or "PG" => "yi-badge-info",
        "MYSQL" or "MARIADB"               => "yi-badge-warning",
        _                                  => "yi-badge-primary"
    };

    private static IEnumerable<(string Type, string Example)> GetConnectionExamples() =>
    [
        ("MSSQL",      "Server=HOST\\SQLEXPRESS;Database=MyDB;Integrated Security=True;TrustServerCertificate=True"),
        ("MSSQL",      "Server=HOST,1433;Database=MyDB;User Id=sa;Password=****;TrustServerCertificate=True"),
        ("PostgreSQL", "Host=HOST;Port=5432;Database=MyDB;Username=postgres;Password=****"),
        ("MySQL",      "Server=HOST;Port=3306;Database=MyDB;User=root;Password=****;"),
    ];
}

@code {
    private bool _loading = true;
    private string? _error;
    private List<YonetIQ.Data.Models.DataSource> _sources = [];
    private YonetIQ.Data.Models.DataSource? _deleteTarget;
    private int? _testingId;
    private readonly Dictionary<int, bool> _testResults = [];

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        _loading = true;
        _error = null;
        var res = await DataSourceSvc.GetAllAsync();
        if (res.IsSuccess) _sources = res.Data ?? [];
        else _error = res.Message;
        _loading = false;
    }

    private async Task TestConnectionAsync(int id)
    {
        _testingId = id;
        _testResults.Remove(id);
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            var dsRes = await DataSourceSvc.GetByIdAsync(id);
            if (!dsRes.IsSuccess || dsRes.Data is null)
            {
                Toast.ShowError("Veri kaynağı bulunamadı.");
                return;
            }

            var ds = dsRes.Data;
            var (success, error) = await DataSourceService.TestConnectionAsync(
                ds.ServerType, ds.PlainConnectionString ?? "");

            _testResults[id] = success;

            if (success) Toast.ShowSuccess($"{ds.Name}: Bağlantı başarılı ✓");
            else Toast.ShowError($"{ds.Name}: {error}");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _testResults[id] = false;
            Toast.ShowError($"Test hatası: {ex.Message}");
        }
        finally
        {
            _testingId = null;
        }
    }

    private void ConfirmDeleteAsync(YonetIQ.Data.Models.DataSource src) => _deleteTarget = src;
    private void CancelDelete() => _deleteTarget = null;

    private async Task DeleteConfirmedAsync()
    {
        if (_deleteTarget is null) return;
        var res = await DataSourceSvc.DeleteAsync(_deleteTarget.Id);
        if (res.IsSuccess)
        {
            Toast.ShowSuccess($"{_deleteTarget.Name} silindi.");
            _deleteTarget = null;
            await LoadAsync();
        }
        else
        {
            Toast.ShowError(res.Message ?? "Silme işlemi başarısız.");
            _deleteTarget = null;
        }
    }

    private static string GetServerIcon(string serverType) => serverType.ToUpperInvariant() switch
    {
        "POSTGRESQL" or "POSTGRES" or "PG" => "bi-database-fill",
        "MYSQL" or "MARIADB"               => "bi-database-fill-gear",
        _                                  => "bi-server"
    };

    private static string GetServerBadgeClass(string serverType) => serverType.ToUpperInvariant() switch
    {
        "POSTGRESQL" or "POSTGRES" or "PG" => "yi-badge-info",
        "MYSQL" or "MARIADB"               => "yi-badge-warning",
        _                                  => "yi-badge-primary"
    };

    private string GetTestBtnClass(int id)
        => _testResults.TryGetValue(id, out var ok) ? (ok ? "yi-btn-success-ghost" : "yi-btn-danger-ghost") : "";
}

@using YonetIQ.Data.Models
@using YonetIQ.Data.Services
@inject LookupService LookupSvc
@inject IToastService Toast

<div class="yi-card border-primary shadow-sm">
    <div class="yi-card-header bg-primary text-white d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
        <h3 class="yi-card-title text-white">@(Decision.Id == 0 ? "Yeni Karar Ekle" : "Kararı Düzenle")</h3>
        @if (Decision.Id != 0)
        {
            <button class="btn btn-close btn-close-white" @onclick="OnCancel"></button>
        }
    </div>
    <div class="yi-card-body">
        <div class="row g-3">
            <div class="col-12">
                <label class="yi-label">Karar İçeriği</label>
                <textarea class="yi-input" rows="3" @bind="Decision.Content" placeholder="Alınan kararı detaylıca yazınız..."></textarea>
            </div>
            <div class="col-12 col-md-4">
                <label class="yi-label">Sorumlu</label>
                <select class="yi-select" value="@Decision.AssigneeId" @onchange="OnAssigneeChanged">
                    <option value="">Seçiniz...</option>
                    @foreach (var user in Users)
                    {
                        <option value="@user.Id">@user.FullName</option>
                    }
                </select>
            </div>
            <div class="col-12 col-md-4">
                <label class="yi-label">Hedef Bitiş</label>
                <input type="date" class="yi-input" value="@Decision.DueDate?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")" @onchange="OnDateChanged" />
            </div>
            <div class="col-12 col-md-4">
                <label class="yi-label">Öncelik</label>
                <select class="yi-select" @bind="Decision.PriorityLookupId">
                    <option value="">Seçiniz...</option>
                    @foreach (var p in Priorities)
                    {
                        <option value="@p.Id">@p.Value</option>
                    }
                </select>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="d-flex gap-2 mt-3">
            <button class="yi-btn-primary" @onclick="OnSave" disabled="@string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Decision.Content)">
                <i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i> @(Decision.Id == 0 ? "Kararı Kaydet" : "Güncelle")
            </button>
            @if (Decision.Id != 0)
            {
                <button class="yi-btn-outline" @onclick="OnCancel">Vazgeç</button>
            }
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    [Parameter] public Decision Decision { get; set; } = new();
    [Parameter] public List<User> Users { get; set; } = [];
    [Parameter] public List<Lookup> Priorities { get; set; } = [];
    [Parameter] public EventCallback OnSave { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback OnCancel { get; set; }

    private void OnAssigneeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var id))
        {
            Decision.AssigneeId = id;
            Decision.AssigneeName = Users.FirstOrDefault(u => u.Id == id)?.FullName ?? string.Empty;
        }
        else
        {
            Decision.AssigneeId = null;
            Decision.AssigneeName = string.Empty;
        }
    }

    private void OnDateChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (DateTime.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var date))
            Decision.DueDate = date;
    }
}

@using YonetIQ.Data.Models
@using YonetIQ.Data.Services
@inject MeetingService MeetingSvc
@inject IToastService Toast

<table class="yi-table yi-table-hover align-middle">
    <thead>
        <tr>
            <th>İçerik</th>
            <th>Öncelik</th>
            <th>Sorumlu</th>
            <th>Bitiş</th>
            <th>Görev</th>
            <th>İşlem</th>
        </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
        @foreach (var decision in Decisions)
        {
            <tr id="decision-@decision.Id" class="@(decision.IsConvertedToTask ? "yi-row-converted" : "")">
                <td class="small">@decision.Content</td>
                <td class="small">
                    <span class="yi-badge @GetPriorityBadgeClass(decision.PriorityLookupId)">
                        @GetLookupValue(decision.PriorityLookupId, Priorities)
                    </span>
                </td>
                <td class="small">@decision.AssigneeName</td>
                <td class="small">@decision.DueDate?.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy")</td>
                <td>
                    @if (decision.IsConvertedToTask)
                    {
                        <a href="/gorev/@decision.LinkedTaskId" class="yi-badge yi-badge-success text-decoration-none">
                            <i class="bi bi-link-45deg"></i> Görev #@decision.LinkedTaskId
                        </a>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <button class="yi-btn-sm yi-btn-outline" @onclick="() => OnConvertToTask.InvokeAsync(decision.Id)">
                            <i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat"></i> Dönüştür
                        </button>
                    }
                </td>
                <td>
                    <div class="d-flex gap-1">
                        <button class="yi-btn-sm yi-btn-outline" @onclick="() => OnEdit.InvokeAsync(decision)">
                            <i class="bi bi-pencil"></i>
                        </button>
                        <button class="yi-btn-sm yi-btn-outline text-danger" @onclick="() => OnDelete.InvokeAsync(decision.Id)">
                            <i class="bi bi-trash"></i>
                        </button>
                        <button class="yi-btn-sm @(ExpandedId == decision.Id ? "yi-btn-primary" : "yi-btn-outline")" 
                                @onclick="() => OnToggleExpand.InvokeAsync(decision.Id)">
                            <i class="bi @(ExpandedId == decision.Id ? "bi-chevron-up" : "bi-chevron-down")"></i>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </td>
            </tr>
            @if (ExpandedId == decision.Id)
            {
                <tr>
                    <td colspan="6" class="bg-light p-3 border-bottom">
                        <div class="yi-card m-0 shadow-sm">
                            <div class="yi-card-body p-3">
                                <YonetIQ.Components.Shared.AttachmentManager EntityType="Decision" EntityId="@decision.Id" />
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </td>
                </tr>
            }
        }
    </tbody>
</table>

@code {
    [Parameter] public List<Decision> Decisions { get; set; } = [];
    [Parameter] public List<Lookup> Priorities { get; set; } = [];
    [Parameter] public int? ExpandedId { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<Decision> OnEdit { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<int> OnDelete { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<int> OnConvertToTask { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<int> OnToggleExpand { get; set; }

    private string GetLookupValue(int? id, List<Lookup> lookups)
    {
        if (id == null) return "Normal";
        return lookups.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == id)?.Value ?? "Sistem";
    }

    private string GetPriorityBadgeClass(int? priorityId)
    {
        return priorityId switch
        {
            4 => "yi-badge-danger",  // Kritik
            3 => "yi-badge-orange",  // Yuksek
            2 => "yi-badge-primary", // Normal
            1 => "yi-badge-secondary", // Dusuk
            _ => "yi-badge-secondary"
        };
    }
}

<AiSidebar @ref="_aiSidebar" Module="meeting" Parameters="@_aiParams" />

@code {
    private AiSidebar? _aiSidebar;
    private Dictionary<string, object> _aiParams => new() { ["meetingId"] = Id };
    private void ToggleAiSidebar() { _aiSidebar?.Toggle(); }

    [Parameter] public int Id { get; set; }
    private bool _isLoading = true;
    private Meeting? _meeting;
    private List<Decision> _decisions = [];
    private List<User> _users = [];
    private List<Lookup> _priorities = [];
    private Decision _newDecision = new();
    private int? _expandedDecisionId;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _isLoading = true;
        _meeting = (await MeetingSvc.GetByIdAsync(Id)).Data;
        _users = (await UserSvc.GetAllAsync()).Data ?? [];
        _priorities = await LookupSvc.ListByGroupAsync("TaskPriority");
        _newDecision.MeetingId = Id;
        _newDecision.PriorityLookupId = _priorities.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Value == "Normal")?.Id;
        await LoadDecisionsAsync();
        _isLoading = false;
    }

    private async Task LoadDecisionsAsync() => _decisions = (await MeetingSvc.ListDecisionsAsync(Id)).Data ?? [];

    private void EditDecision(Decision d) 
    { 
        _newDecision = new Decision 
        { 
            Id = d.Id, 
            MeetingId = d.MeetingId, 
            Content = d.Content, 
            AssigneeId = d.AssigneeId, 
            AssigneeName = d.AssigneeName, 
            DueDate = d.DueDate, 
            PriorityLookupId = d.PriorityLookupId 
        }; 
    }

    private void CancelEdit() 
    { 
        _newDecision = new Decision 
        { 
            MeetingId = Id, 
            PriorityLookupId = _priorities.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Value == "Normal")?.Id 
        }; 
    }

    private async Task SaveDecisionAsync()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_newDecision.Content)) return;
        var res = await MeetingSvc.SaveDecisionAsync(_newDecision);
        if (res.IsSuccess) { Toast.ShowSuccess("Karar kaydedildi."); CancelEdit(); await LoadDecisionsAsync(); }
        else { Toast.ShowError(res.Message); }
    }

    private async Task DeleteDecisionAsync(int decisionId)
    {
        var res = await MeetingSvc.DeleteDecisionAsync(decisionId);
        if (res.IsSuccess) { Toast.ShowSuccess("Karar silindi."); await LoadDecisionsAsync(); }
        else { Toast.ShowError(res.Message); }
    }

    private async Task ConvertToTaskAsync(int decisionId)
    {
        var res = await MeetingSvc.ConvertDecisionToTaskAsync(decisionId);
        if (res.IsSuccess) { Toast.ShowSuccess($"Görev oluşturuldu (# {res.Data})"); await LoadDecisionsAsync(); }
        else { Toast.ShowError(res.Message); }
    }

    private void ToggleExpand(int id) => _expandedDecisionId = (_expandedDecisionId == id) ? null : id;
    private void ScrollToDecisions() => Nav.NavigateTo(Nav.Uri.Split('#', StringSplitOptions.None)[0] + "#decisions-section");
}

                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
}

<AiSidebar @ref="_aiSidebar" Module="meeting" Parameters="@_aiParams" />

@code {
    [Parameter] public int? Id { get; set; }

    private AiSidebar? _aiSidebar;
    private Dictionary<string, object> _aiParams => new()
    {
        ["meetingId"] = Id ?? 0
    };

    private void ToggleAiSidebar()
    {
        _aiSidebar?.Toggle();
    }

    private bool _loading = true;
    private string? _errorMessage;
    private Meeting _model = new() { MeetingDate = DateTime.Today.AddHours(9) };

    private string FormTitle => _model.Id == 0 ? "Yeni Toplantı Planla" : "Toplantı Düzenle";

    private DateTime _selectedDate = DateTime.Today;
    private TimeSpan _selectedTime = new(9, 0, 0);

    private string MeetingDateInput
    {
        get => _selectedDate.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
        set
        {
            if (DateTime.TryParse(value, out var parsed))
            {
                _selectedDate = parsed.Date;
                UpdateMeetingDate();
            }
        }
    }

    private string MeetingTimeInput
    {
        get => _selectedTime.ToString(@"hh\:mm");
        set
        {
            if (TimeSpan.TryParse(value, out var parsed))
            {
                _selectedTime = parsed;
                UpdateMeetingDate();
            }
        }
    }


    private string RecurrenceEndDateInput
    {
        get => _model.RecurrenceEndDate?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") ?? _selectedDate.AddMonths(1).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
    }

    private int InstanceCount
    {
        get
        {
            if (_model.RecurrenceType == "None" || !_model.RecurrenceEndDate.HasValue) return 0;
            var count = 0;
            var current = _model.MeetingDate;
            var end = _model.RecurrenceEndDate.Value;
            var interval = _model.RecurrenceInterval < 1 ? 1 : _model.RecurrenceInterval;
            while (count < 500)
            {
                current = _model.RecurrenceType switch
                {
                    "Daily"   => current.AddDays(interval),
                    "Weekly"  => current.AddDays(7 * interval),
                    "Monthly" => current.AddMonths(interval),
                    "Yearly"  => current.AddYears(interval),
                    _         => end.AddDays(1)
                };
                if (current > end) break;
                count++;
            }
            return count;
        }
    }

    private Task OnMeetingDateChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (DateTime.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var parsed))
        {
            _selectedDate = parsed.Date;
            UpdateMeetingDate();
        }

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task OnMeetingTimeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (TimeSpan.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var parsed))
        {
            _selectedTime = parsed;
            UpdateMeetingDate();
        }

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        if (Id.HasValue)
        {
            var result = await MeetingSvc.GetByIdAsync(Id.Value);
            if (result.IsSuccess && result.Data is not null)
            {
                _model = result.Data;
            }
            else if (!result.IsSuccess)
            {
                _errorMessage = result.Message;
            }
        }

        _selectedDate = _model.MeetingDate.Date;
        _selectedTime = _model.MeetingDate.TimeOfDay;

        _loading = false;
    }

    private Task OnRecurrenceTypeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _model.RecurrenceType = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "None";
        if (_model.RecurrenceType != "None" && !_model.RecurrenceEndDate.HasValue)
            _model.RecurrenceEndDate = _selectedDate.AddMonths(1);
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task OnRecurrenceEndDateChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (DateTime.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var parsed))
            _model.RecurrenceEndDate = parsed.Date;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private void UpdateMeetingDate()
    {
        _model.MeetingDate = _selectedDate.Date.Add(_selectedTime);
    }

    private async Task SaveAsync()
    {
        _errorMessage = null;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_model.Title))
        {
            _errorMessage = "Başlık zorunludur.";
            return;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_model.Location))
        {
            _errorMessage = "Yer bilgisi zorunludur.";
            return;
        }

        UpdateMeetingDate();

        var result = await MeetingSvc.SaveAsync(_model);
        
        if (result.IsSuccess)
        {
            Toast.ShowSuccess("Toplantı kaydedildi.");
            Nav.NavigateTo($"/toplanti/{result.Data}");
        }
        else
        {
            _errorMessage = result.Message;
            Toast.ShowError(result.Message);
        }
    }
}

@code {
    private AiSidebar? _aiSidebar;
    private Dictionary<string, object> _aiParams = new();
    private void ToggleAiSidebar() { _aiSidebar?.Toggle(); }

    // Sayfa yükleme durumu.
    private bool _loading = true;
    
    // Arama metni.
    private string _searchQuery = string.Empty;
    
    // Tüm toplantıların listesi.
    private List<Meeting> _meetings = [];

    // Görünür kullanıcı adları seti (toplantı katılımcı filtresi için)
    private HashSet<string> _visibleUserNames = [];

    private string _currentRole => SessionSvc.ActiveUser?.Role ?? string.Empty;
    private bool IsAdmin       => _currentRole == "Genel Müdür";
    private bool IsUnitManager => _currentRole is "Müdür" or "Direktör";

    // İstatistiksel özetler için hesaplanmış özellikler.
    private int TotalMeetings => _meetings.Count;
    private int ThisMonthMeetings => _meetings.Count(x => x.MeetingDate.Month == DateTime.Today.Month && x.MeetingDate.Year == DateTime.Today.Year);
    private int UpcomingMeetings => _meetings.Count(x => x.MeetingDate.Date >= DateTime.Today);
    private int MeetingsWithLinks => _meetings.Count(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.MeetingLink));

    /// <summary>
    /// Arama kriterine göre filtrelenmiş ve tarihe göre sıralanmış toplantı listesi.
    /// </summary>
    private List<Meeting> FilteredMeetings => _meetings
        .Where(x => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchQuery)
            || x.Title.Contains(_searchQuery, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || (x.Location?.Contains(_searchQuery, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false))
        .OrderByDescending(x => x.MeetingDate)
        .ToList();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await BuildVisibleUserNamesAsync();
        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private async Task BuildVisibleUserNamesAsync()
    {
        if (IsAdmin) { _visibleUserNames = []; return; }

        var ownName = SessionSvc.ActiveUser?.FullName ?? string.Empty;

        if (IsUnitManager)
        {
            var deptId = SessionSvc.ActiveUser?.DepartmentLookupId;
            if (deptId.HasValue)
            {
                var deptUsers = await UserSvc.GetUsersByDepartmentAsync(deptId.Value);
                _visibleUserNames = deptUsers.Select(u => u.FullName).ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                _visibleUserNames.Add(ownName);
                return;
            }
        }
        _visibleUserNames = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) { ownName };
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        _loading = true;
        var result = await MeetingSvc.GetAllAsync();
        if (result.IsSuccess)
        {
            var all = result.Data ?? [];
            if (IsAdmin)
            {
                _meetings = all;
            }
            else
            {
                // Participants stringinde görünür kullanıcılardan en az biri geçiyorsa göster
                _meetings = all.Where(m =>
                    _visibleUserNames.Any(name =>
                        m.Participants.Contains(name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))).ToList();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            Toast.ShowError(result.Message);
            _meetings = [];
        }
        _loading = false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Belirtilen toplantı kaydını siler ve listeyi yeniler.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task DeleteAsync(int id)
    {
        var result = await MeetingSvc.DeleteAsync(id);
        if (result.IsSuccess)
        {
            Toast.ShowSuccess("Toplantı silindi.");
            await LoadAsync();
        }
        else
        {
            Toast.ShowError(result.Message);
        }
    }
}

@code {
    private AiSidebar? _aiSidebar;
    private Dictionary<string, object> _aiParams => new()
    {
        ["noteId"] = _selected?.Id ?? 0
    };
    private void ToggleAiSidebar() { _aiSidebar?.Toggle(); }

    // ─── Not Yönetimi ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _showConvertPanel;
    private string? _tagFilter;

    private List<PersonalNote> _notes = [];
    private List<PersonalNote> _dueReminders = [];
    private List<string> _allTags = [];
    private List<Lookup> _priorities = [];

    private PersonalNote _editing = new();
    private PersonalNote? _selected;

    // Göreve dönüştürme
    private string _taskTitle = string.Empty;
    private DateTime? _taskDueDate;
    private int _taskPriorityId;

    // ─── AI Chat ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    private bool _showChat;
    private bool _aiChatting;
    private string _chatInput = string.Empty;
    private List<ChatMsg> _chatHistory = [];
    private ParsedNote? _parsedNote;

    private record ChatMsg(string Role, string Text);
    private record ParsedNote(string Title, string Content, string Tags);

    // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    private int UserId => SessionSvc.ActiveUser.UserId;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _priorities = await LookupSvc.ListByGroupAsync("TaskPriority");
        if (_priorities.Count > 0) _taskPriorityId = _priorities[0].Id;

        await LoadNotesAsync();

        var reminderRes = await NoteSvc.GetDueRemindersAsync(UserId);
        _dueReminders = reminderRes.Data ?? [];

        _loading = false;
    }

    // ─── Not Listesi ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    private async Task LoadNotesAsync()
    {
        var res = await NoteSvc.ListAsync(UserId, _tagFilter);
        _notes = res.Data ?? [];
        _allTags = _notes
            .SelectMany(n => GetTags(n.Tags))
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(t => t)
            .ToList();
    }

    private void NewNote()
    {
        _editing = new PersonalNote { UserId = UserId, CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow };
        _selected = null;
        _showConvertPanel = false;
        _showChat = false;
        _chatHistory = [];
        _parsedNote = null;
    }

    private void SelectNote(PersonalNote note)
    {
        _selected = note;
        _editing = new PersonalNote
        {
            Id = note.Id, UserId = note.UserId, Title = note.Title,
            Content = note.Content, Tags = note.Tags,
            ReminderAt = note.ReminderAt, IsReminderDismissed = note.IsReminderDismissed,
            LinkedTaskId = note.LinkedTaskId, CreatedAt = note.CreatedAt
        };
        _taskTitle = note.Title;
        _showConvertPanel = false;
        _showChat = false;
        _chatHistory = [];
        _parsedNote = null;
    }

    // ─── Not CRUD ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    private async Task SaveNoteAsync()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_editing.Title))
        {
            Toast.ShowWarning("Başlık zorunludur.");
            return;
        }
        _editing.UserId = UserId;
        var res = await NoteSvc.SaveAsync(_editing);
        if (res.IsSuccess)
        {
            _editing.Id = res.Data;
            Toast.ShowSuccess("Not kaydedildi.");
            await LoadNotesAsync();
        }
        else Toast.ShowError(res.Message);
    }

    private async Task DeleteNoteAsync()
    {
        if (_editing.Id == 0) return;
        var res = await NoteSvc.DeleteAsync(_editing.Id, UserId);
        if (res.IsSuccess)
        {
            Toast.ShowSuccess("Not silindi.");
            _editing = new PersonalNote();
            _selected = null;
            await LoadNotesAsync();
        }
        else Toast.ShowError(res.Message);
    }

    private async Task DismissReminderAsync(PersonalNote note)
    {
        await NoteSvc.DismissReminderAsync(note.Id, UserId);
        _dueReminders.Remove(note);
    }

    private async Task ConvertToTaskAsync()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_taskTitle))
        {
            Toast.ShowWarning("Görev başlığı zorunludur.");
            return;
        }
        var task = new TaskItem
        {
            Title = _taskTitle,
            Description = _editing.Content,
            AssigneeId = UserId,
            AssigneeName = SessionSvc.ActiveUser.FullName,
            DueDate = _taskDueDate,
            PriorityLookupId = _taskPriorityId,
            StatusLookupId = (await LookupSvc.GetLookupIdAsync("TaskStatus", "Bekliyor")).Data ?? 0,
            SourceEntityType = "PersonalNote",
            SourceEntityId = _editing.Id
        };
        var res = await NoteSvc.ConvertToTaskAsync(_editing.Id, UserId, task);
        if (res.IsSuccess)
        {
            _editing.LinkedTaskId = res.Data;
            _showConvertPanel = false;
            Toast.ShowSuccess($"Görev #{res.Data} oluşturuldu.");
            await LoadNotesAsync();
        }
        else Toast.ShowError(res.Message);
    }

    // ─── AI Chat ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    private Task StartChatAsync()
    {
        _showChat = true;
        _chatHistory = [];
        _parsedNote = null;

        var greeting = (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_editing.Content))
            ? "Merhaba! 👋 Hangi konuda not almak istiyorsunuz? Aklınızdakileri özgürce anlatın — ben de güzel bir nota dönüştüreyim."
            : $"Notunuzu gördüm: **{_editing.Title}**. Bu notu nasıl geliştirebilirim? Daha fazla detay eklememi, yapılandırmamı ya da farklı bir şey yapmamı ister misiniz?";

        _chatHistory.Add(new ChatMsg("model", greeting));
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private async Task SendChatMessageAsync()
    {
        var userText = _chatInput.Trim();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(userText) || _aiChatting) return;

        _chatInput = string.Empty;
        _chatHistory.Add(new ChatMsg("user", userText));
        _aiChatting = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        // İlk kullanıcı mesajına mevcut not bağlamını ekle
        var isFirstUserMsg = _chatHistory.Count(m => m.Role == "user") == 1;
        var messageToSend = userText;
        if (isFirstUserMsg && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_editing.Content))
        {
            messageToSend = $"[Mevcut not bağlamı — Başlık: {_editing.Title} | İçerik: {_editing.Content} | Etiketler: {_editing.Tags}]\n\n{userText}";
        }

        // Konuşma geçmişini hazırla (son eklenen user mesajı hariç — onu messageToSend olarak göndereceğiz)
        var history = _chatHistory
            .Take(_chatHistory.Count - 1)
            .Select(m => (m.Role, m.Text))
            .ToList();

        var res = await NoteChatSvc.ChatAsync(history, messageToSend);
        var aiText = res.IsSuccess ? res.Data! : "⚠️ AI asistana şu an ulaşılamıyor. Lütfen tekrar deneyin.";

        _chatHistory.Add(new ChatMsg("model", aiText));
        _parsedNote = TryParseNote(aiText);
        _aiChatting = false;

        StateHasChanged();
        await ScrollChatAsync();
    }

    private async Task OnChatKeyDown(KeyboardEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Key == "Enter" && !e.ShiftKey)
            await SendChatMessageAsync();
    }

    private void ApplyParsedNote()
    {
        if (_parsedNote is null) return;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_parsedNote.Title))   _editing.Title   = _parsedNote.Title;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_parsedNote.Content)) _editing.Content = _parsedNote.Content;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_parsedNote.Tags))    _editing.Tags    = _parsedNote.Tags;
        _showChat = false;
        Toast.ShowInfo("Not alanları AI önerisiyle dolduruldu. Kontrol edip kaydedebilirsiniz.");
    }

    private void ApplyMessageAsNote(string text)
    {
        var parsed = TryParseNote(text);
        if (parsed is null) return;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parsed.Title))   _editing.Title   = parsed.Title;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parsed.Content)) _editing.Content = parsed.Content;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parsed.Tags))    _editing.Tags    = parsed.Tags;
        _showChat = false;
        Toast.ShowInfo("Not alanları AI önerisiyle dolduruldu. Kontrol edip kaydedebilirsiniz.");
    }

    private async Task ScrollChatAsync()
    {
        try { await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("scrollElementToBottom", "chatContainer"); }
        catch { /* JS interop mevcut değilse sessizce geç */ }
    }

    // ─── Parse Yardımcıları ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    private static bool HasParsedNote(string text) =>
        text.Contains("---NOT HAZIR---", StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
        text.Contains("---SON---", StringComparison.Ordinal);

    private static ParsedNote? TryParseNote(string text)
    {
        const string startMarker = "---NOT HAZIR---";
        const string endMarker   = "---SON---";

        var si = text.IndexOf(startMarker, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        var ei = text.IndexOf(endMarker,   StringComparison.Ordinal);
        if (si < 0 || ei <= si) return null;

        var block = text[(si + startMarker.Length)..ei];
        var title   = ExtractSingleLine(block, "Başlık:");
        var content = ExtractMultiLine(block,  "İçerik:", "Etiketler:");
        var tags    = ExtractSingleLine(block, "Etiketler:");

        return (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(title) && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(content))
            ? null
            : new ParsedNote(title, content, tags);
    }

    private static string ExtractSingleLine(string block, string prefix)
    {
        var line = block.Split('\n')
            .Select(l => l.Trim())
            .FirstOrDefault(l => l.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        return line is null ? string.Empty : line[prefix.Length..].Trim();
    }

    private static string ExtractMultiLine(string block, string startPrefix, string endPrefix)
    {
        var lines = block.Split('\n').Select(l => l.Trim()).ToList();
        var si = lines.FindIndex(l => l.StartsWith(startPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        if (si < 0) return string.Empty;

        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine(lines[si][startPrefix.Length..].Trim());
        for (int i = si + 1; i < lines.Count; i++)
        {
            if (lines[i].StartsWith(endPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) break;
            sb.AppendLine(lines[i]);
        }
        return sb.ToString().Trim();
    }

    /// <summary>Chat görünümünde NOT HAZIR bloğunu gizler, sadece sohbet metnini gösterir.</summary>
    private static string CleanChatText(string text)
    {
        const string startMarker = "---NOT HAZIR---";
        var si = text.IndexOf(startMarker, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        return si > 0 ? text[..si].TrimEnd() : text;
    }

    // ─── Diğer Yardımcılar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    private async Task FilterByTag(string? tag)
    {
        _tagFilter = tag;
        await LoadNotesAsync();
    }

    private void OnReminderChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _editing.ReminderAt = DateTime.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var dt) ? dt.ToUniversalTime() : null;
    }

    private static string FormatForInput(DateTime? dt) =>
        dt.HasValue ? dt.Value.ToLocalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm") : string.Empty;

    private static string TruncateContent(string content) =>
        content.Length > 80 ? content[..80] + "..." : content;

    private static IEnumerable<string> GetTags(string tags) =>
        tags.Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries)
            .Where(t => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(t));
}

<AiSidebar @ref="_aiSidebar" Module="okr" Parameters="@_aiParams" />

@code {
    private AiSidebar? _aiSidebar;
    private Dictionary<string, object> _aiParams => new()
    {
        ["objectiveId"] = _editObj?.Id ?? 0
    };
    private void ToggleAiSidebar() { _aiSidebar?.Toggle(); }

    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _showObjectiveModal;
    private bool _saving;
    private string? _objError;
    private string _filterLevel = "";
    private int _filterYear = 2026;

    private List<Objective> _objectives = [];
    private List<User> _users = [];
    private List<TaskItem> _tasks = [];
    private Objective _editObj = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        var uRes = await UserSvc.GetAllAsync();
        _users = uRes.IsSuccess ? (uRes.Data ?? []) : [];

        var tRes = await TaskSvc.ListAsync();
        _tasks = tRes.IsSuccess ? (tRes.Data ?? []) : [];

        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        _loading = true;
        var res = await OkrSvc.ListAsync(_filterYear, null, string.IsNullOrEmpty(_filterLevel) ? null : _filterLevel);
        if (res.IsSuccess && res.Data is not null)
        {
            _objectives = [];
            foreach (var obj in res.Data)
            {
                var detail = await OkrSvc.GetWithKeyResultsAsync(obj.Id);
                _objectives.Add(detail.IsSuccess && detail.Data is not null ? detail.Data : obj);
            }
        }
        else _objectives = [];
        _loading = false;
    }

    private void OpenCreateModal()
    {
        _editObj = new Objective { Year = _filterYear, KeyResults = [] };
        _objError = null;
        _showObjectiveModal = true;
    }

    private async Task OpenDetailModal(int id)
    {
        var res = await OkrSvc.GetWithKeyResultsAsync(id);
        if (res.IsSuccess && res.Data is not null)
        {
            _editObj = res.Data;
            _objError = null;
            _showObjectiveModal = true;
        }
    }

    private void OnOwnerChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var oid = int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var parsed) ? parsed : 0;
        _editObj.OwnerId = oid == 0 ? null : oid;
        _editObj.OwnerName = _users.FirstOrDefault(u => u.Id == oid)?.FullName ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private void OnKrTaskChanged(KeyResult kr, ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var tid = int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var parsed) ? parsed : 0;
        kr.LinkedTaskId = tid == 0 ? null : tid;
    }

    private void AddKr() => _editObj.KeyResults.Add(new KeyResult { ObjectiveId = _editObj.Id });
    private void RemoveKr(KeyResult kr) => _editObj.KeyResults.Remove(kr);

    private async Task SaveObjectiveAsync()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_editObj.Title)) { _objError = "Başlık zorunludur."; return; }

        _saving = true;
        _objError = null;
        var userId = SessionSvc.ActiveUser.UserId;
        var res = await OkrSvc.SaveObjectiveAsync(_editObj, userId);
        if (res.IsSuccess)
        {
            var objId = res.Data;
            foreach (var kr in _editObj.KeyResults.Where(k => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(k.Title)))
            {
                kr.ObjectiveId = objId;
                await OkrSvc.SaveKeyResultAsync(kr, userId);
            }
            _showObjectiveModal = false;
            Toast.ShowSuccess("Hedef kaydedildi.");
            await LoadAsync();
        }
        else _objError = res.Message ?? "Kayıt başarısız.";
        _saving = false;
    }

    private async Task UpdateKrAsync(int krId, decimal value)
    {
        var userId = SessionSvc.ActiveUser.UserId;
        await OkrSvc.UpdateKeyResultAsync(krId, value, userId);
        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private async Task DeleteAsync(int id)
    {
        var res = await OkrSvc.DeleteObjectiveAsync(id, SessionSvc.ActiveUser.UserId);
        if (res.IsSuccess) { Toast.ShowSuccess("Hedef silindi."); await LoadAsync(); }
        else Toast.ShowError(res.Message);
    }
}

@code {
    private bool   _loading = true;
    private User?  _user;
    private string _roleName       = string.Empty;
    private string _departmentName = string.Empty;

    // Profil form
    private string _editFullName = string.Empty;
    private string _editEmail    = string.Empty;
    private string? _profileError;

    // Şifre form
    private string _currentPassword = string.Empty;
    private string _newPassword      = string.Empty;
    private string _confirmPassword  = string.Empty;
    private string? _passwordError;
    private bool _showCurrent;
    private bool _showNew;
    private bool _showConfirm;

    // Telegram widget
    private string?  _botUsername;
    private bool     _widgetInitialized = false;
    private string?  _tgVerifyError;
    private DotNetObjectReference<Profile>? _dotNetRef;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        if (!SessionSvc.IsLoggedIn)
        {
            Nav.NavigateTo("/giris");
            return;
        }

        var res = await UserSvc.GetByIdAsync(SessionSvc.ActiveUser.UserId);
        if (res.IsSuccess && res.Data is not null)
        {
            _user = res.Data;
            _editFullName = _user.FullName;
            _editEmail    = _user.Email ?? string.Empty;

            var roles = await LookupSvc.ListByGroupAsync("UserRole");
            _roleName = roles.FirstOrDefault(r => r.Id == _user.RoleLookupId)?.Value ?? "—";

            if (_user.DepartmentLookupId.HasValue)
            {
                var depts = await LookupSvc.ListByGroupAsync("Department");
                _departmentName = depts.FirstOrDefault(d => d.Id == _user.DepartmentLookupId)?.Value ?? string.Empty;
            }
        }

        _botUsername = await SettingsSvc.GetAsync("Telegram.BotUsername");

        _loading = false;
    }

    protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
    {
        // Widget'ı bir kere başlat: yüklenme bitti, bot adı var, kullanıcı bağlı değil
        if (!_loading
            && !_widgetInitialized
            && _user is not null
            && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_user.TelegramChatId)
            && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_botUsername))
        {
            _widgetInitialized = true;
            _dotNetRef = DotNetObjectReference.Create(this);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("initTelegramWidget", "tg-widget-container", _botUsername, _dotNetRef);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Telegram Login Widget'tan gelen callback — JS tarafından çağrılır.
    /// </summary>
    [JSInvokable]
    public async Task OnTelegramCallback(string userJson)
    {
        _tgVerifyError = null;
        try
        {
            // JSON'u dictionary'e çevir
            var data = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, System.Text.Json.JsonElement>>(userJson);
            if (data is null) { _tgVerifyError = "Telegram verisi okunamadı."; await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged); return; }

            // string dictionary'e dönüştür
            var strData = data.ToDictionary(kv => kv.Key, kv => kv.Value.ToString());

            // Sunucu tarafında imza doğrulama
            var valid = await TelegramSvc.VerifyLoginWidgetAsync(strData);
            if (!valid)
            {
                _tgVerifyError = "Telegram doğrulaması başarısız. Lütfen tekrar deneyin.";
                await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
                return;
            }

            // Chat ID'yi kaydet
            if (!strData.TryGetValue("id", out var chatId) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(chatId))
            {
                _tgVerifyError = "Telegram'dan geçerli bir kullanıcı ID'si alınamadı.";
                await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
                return;
            }

            _user!.TelegramChatId = chatId;
            var saveRes = await UserSvc.UpdateTelegramChatIdAsync(_user.Id, chatId);

            if (saveRes.IsSuccess)
            {
                // SessionInfo'yu da güncelle
                SessionSvc.ActiveUser.TelegramChatId = chatId;
                Toast.ShowSuccess("Telegram hesabınız başarıyla bağlandı!");
            }
            else
            {
                _tgVerifyError = saveRes.Message ?? "Kayıt sırasında hata oluştu.";
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _tgVerifyError = $"Beklenmedik hata: {ex.Message}";
        }

        await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Telegram bağlantısını kaldırır.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task UnlinkTelegramAsync()
    {
        if (_user is null) return;

        var result = await UserSvc.UpdateTelegramChatIdAsync(_user.Id, null);

        if (result.IsSuccess)
        {
            _user.TelegramChatId = null;
            SessionSvc.ActiveUser.TelegramChatId = null;
            _widgetInitialized = false; // Widget yeniden başlatılabilsin
            Toast.ShowSuccess("Telegram bağlantısı kaldırıldı.");
        }
        else
        {
            Toast.ShowError(result.Message ?? "İşlem başarısız.");
        }
    }

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        if (_dotNetRef is not null)
        {
            try { await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("disposeDotNetRef", _dotNetRef); } catch { /* sayfa zaten kapatıldı */ }
            _dotNetRef.Dispose();
        }
    }

    private async Task SaveProfileAsync()
    {
        _profileError = null;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_editFullName))
        {
            _profileError = "Ad Soyad boş bırakılamaz.";
            return;
        }

        _user!.FullName = _editFullName.Trim();
        _user.Email     = _editEmail.Trim();

        var result = await UserSvc.SaveAsync(_user);
        if (result.IsSuccess)
        {
            Toast.ShowSuccess("Profil bilgileri güncellendi.");
        }
        else
        {
            _profileError = result.Message;
            Toast.ShowError(result.Message);
        }
    }

    private async Task ChangePasswordAsync()
    {
        _passwordError = null;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_currentPassword))
        {
            _passwordError = "Mevcut şifrenizi girin.";
            return;
        }

        if (_newPassword.Length < 6)
        {
            _passwordError = "Yeni şifre en az 6 karakter olmalıdır.";
            return;
        }

        if (_newPassword != _confirmPassword)
        {
            _passwordError = "Yeni şifreler eşleşmiyor.";
            return;
        }

        var result = await AuthSvc.ChangePasswordAsync(SessionSvc.ActiveUser.UserId, _currentPassword, _newPassword);
        if (result.IsSuccess)
        {
            Toast.ShowSuccess("Şifreniz başarıyla güncellendi.");
            _currentPassword = _newPassword = _confirmPassword = string.Empty;
        }
        else
        {
            _passwordError = result.Message;
            Toast.ShowError(result.Message);
        }
    }

    private static (int Pct, string Color, string Label) GetPasswordStrength(string pwd)
    {
        var score = 0;
        if (pwd.Length >= 8) score++;
        if (pwd.Length >= 12) score++;
        if (pwd.Any(char.IsUpper)) score++;
        if (pwd.Any(char.IsDigit)) score++;
        if (pwd.Any(c => !char.IsLetterOrDigit(c))) score++;

        return score switch
        {
            0 or 1 => (20,  "#d63939", "Çok Zayıf"),
            2      => (40,  "#f59f00", "Zayıf"),
            3      => (60,  "#f59f00", "Orta"),
            4      => (80,  "#2fb344", "Güçlü"),
            _      => (100, "#0ca678", "Çok Güçlü"),
        };
    }
}
